name: get_guardduty_findings
description: List AWS GuardDuty findings filtered by severity, region, and/or account. Returns finding IDs and summary information for detected threats.

severity.description: Minimum severity level to filter findings. One of: LOW (1-3.9), MEDIUM (4-6.9), HIGH (7-8.9), CRITICAL (9-10). Defaults to MEDIUM.

region.description: AWS region to query GuardDuty findings in (e.g. us-east-1). Defaults to the Lambda execution region.

account_id.description: AWS account ID to scope findings to. Optional — defaults to the current account.

max_results.description: Maximum number of findings to return (1-50, default 20).

name: describe_guardduty_finding
description: Retrieve a detailed, human-readable explanation of a single GuardDuty finding including the threat type, affected resources, observed behavior, and recommended next steps.

finding_id.description: The unique identifier of the GuardDuty finding to describe.

region.description: AWS region where the finding exists. Defaults to the Lambda execution region.

name: archive_guardduty_finding
description: Archive (suppress) one or more GuardDuty findings so they no longer appear in the active findings list. CAUTION: this is a write action that permanently suppresses findings — only use when a finding is a confirmed false positive or has been fully remediated.

finding_ids.description: List of GuardDuty finding IDs to archive.

region.description: AWS region where the findings exist. Defaults to the Lambda execution region.

name: triage_guardduty_finding
description: Run an automated triage playbook against a GuardDuty finding. Classifies the finding, enriches it with contextual resource information, assesses risk, and returns a structured remediation recommendation.

finding_id.description: The unique identifier of the GuardDuty finding to triage.

region.description: AWS region where the finding exists. Defaults to the Lambda execution region.

name: list_guardduty_findings_since
description: List GuardDuty findings that were automatically ingested by AgentSOAR via EventBridge in the last N hours. Useful for reviewing what happened while the agent was not actively queried. Returns findings from the local DynamoDB store, not the live GuardDuty API.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (1-168). Defaults to 24.
